profile.headline: Software Engineer | Clinical Health Insights | Communications
profile.summary:
My passions include Software Development and Machine Learning with the ultimate goal of enabling every person and organization to achieve more. Past projects include building classroom tools to be used in modern-day higher education systems through the TIILT lab at Northwestern with Marcelo Worsley. 

My desire to join supportive and challenging communities in which I can give back makes me a valuable asset in any professional work environment.

positions.title: Sony X Northwestern Collaboration
positions.description: A collaboration between one other student, Marcelo Worsley, and myself at Northwestern University and the Sony Corporation in order to build a discussion capture tool.

positions.title: TIILT Lab
positions.description: Technological Innovations for Inclusive Learning and Teaching (TIILT) lab mainly focuses on building STEM Lab tools for students and teachers to interact with.

positions.title: Peer Mentor
positions.description: Part of the Peer Mentor program for an introduction to AI class at Northwestern University. Includes hosting office hours and helping grade exams.

positions.title: MakerSpace Instructor
positions.description: Administrator for the MakerSpace activity at the GCDS Summer Camp. Managed 11 sections of 20 children from ages 4-12. Curriculum included: Building your own website, robotics, game design, various Raspberry Pi projects, and other tinker activities.

positions.title: Latin America Tax Intern
positions.description: Summer internship for the Latin America Tax Department.

projects.title: Hospital Malnutrition
projects.description: A project in which we use a microphone array, force sensitive resistors, and a smart necklace from the HABits lab at NU to detect malnutrition in patients recovering from surgery.
